# 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

## 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`press_release.txt` 第 3115 行 / `financial_statements.txt` 表格）：

| 期间 | 收入（百万美元） |
|---|---|
| FY26 Q4（截至 2026-06-30） | $39,306 |
| FY25 Q4（截至 2025-06-30） | $29,878 |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \approx 31.55\%$$

微软按四舍五入报告为 **32%（按报告口径）**；按固定汇率口径为 **31%**（`press_release.txt` 第 3115 行："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"）。

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（原话引用）

以下均来自 `transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 介绍 Intelligent Cloud 分部时的发言（位置 ~24780–25950）：

> **(a)** *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."*

> **(b)** *"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."*

> **(c)** *"That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."*

> **(d)** *"Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."*

> **(e)** *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."*

---

## 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述 逐条标注

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) | Azure 收入增长 43%；客户需求持续超过可用产能 | **混合**：增长 43% 是已发生的事实（有具体数字）；"continues to exceed" 描述的是电话会时点的**当前状态**，但其延续性暗含对未来趋势的判断 | 43% 是已报告的财务结果；"continues" 一词暗示该状态在未来仍会延续，属于前瞻性暗示 |
| (b) | CPU/GPU fleet 效率提升；流程改进实现新产能提前交付 | **已发生的事实** | "efficiency gains" 和 "process improvements to enable earlier delivery" 描述的是 Q4 期间**已经完成并产生效果**的行动，且直接解释了当期"growth was ahead of expectations" |
| (c) | 当季额外 Azure 产能被快速变现 | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" 是对 Q4 已发生行为的过去式陈述 |
| (d) | GitHub Copilot 消耗强于预期（6月业务模式变更后） | **已发生的事实** | "June business model change" 是已实施的具体事件；"stronger-than-expected" 是对 Q4 实际结果的回溯性评价 |
| (e) | on-premises server 续约中更高的当期收入确认 | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是 Q4 已完成的续约交易及其收入确认结果 |

**总结**：在上述 5 条归因中，**(b)(c)(d)(e)** 均为已发生事实的陈述；**(a)** 中的"客户需求持续超过产能"是一个混合项——"需求超过产能"本身是电话会陈述的当前事实，但其延续性措辞（"continues"）隐含了对未来供需格局的前瞻性判断。此外需注意，电话会后续（`transcript.txt` 位置 ~32535）Amy Hood 给出的下季度指引（"we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%"）是**明确的前瞻性表述**，但不属于对 Q4 增长本身的归因。
